fullPassage: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is one of the biggest catch phrases these days. While cutting-edge technology might have benefits for many people, it is also a cause of concern for those trying to start a career. With so many jobs disappearing, what kind of career should you pursue, and what skills should you have to survive in the AI age? Whether you like it or hate it, AI technology is probably here to stay. Here are the core competencies you need to foster for a great career in the age of AI. Ask the right questions, rather than merely find answers. Before the Internet, people with vast knowledge were considered to be the most talented. Quiz shows with difficult questions, such as the name of the famous stone castle built by Cormac MacCarthy in 1446, used to be very popular. However, things have changed, and now with the presence of AI, many people question why one would memorize such information. Unlike in the past, this is because you can quickly find answers on the Internet, and if you want, an AI assistant will even find an answer for you. In 2011, the 74-time winner of a popular American quiz show competed against a supercomputer. The fact that the computer won a resounding victory shows that humans cannot keep up with computers in finding factual information. If that person were to compete with current AI, he would probably lose by a larger margin. We don't need to memorize all the answers, and no matter how hard we try, we cannot rival AI in memorizing vast quantities of information. What we need to focus on is obtaining the "right" answers from AI, and the key is to ask the right questions to elicit the answer you want from AI. That is not to say you don't need to study. To ask the right questions, you must understand the context in which you're asking the question, and you also need background knowledge on the topic. When AI provides an answer, you must also be able to tell how accurate the answer is. We are currently in an era where the ability to use information is more important than having all the details memorized. We must be able to do what AI is not good at rather than focusing on what AI does best. Develop critical thinking skills for evaluating information. AI can often find the information we want quickly, but there are problems with this. AI creates a lot of false or biased information. Further, AI cannot understand the intentions of the person who created the information, nor does it have the ability to judge whether the information is right or wrong. Moreover, stories of AI providing fake information are often reported. For example, there was a case of a lawyer who submitted non-existent cases made by AI to a real court. There has also been an example of AI recommending restaurants that didn't exist. Just as much as misleading information, feeding biased information into AI causes incorrect or even harmful output. A world-famous Internet company had AI study ten years of employee records to create a new employee selection algorithm. However, the company decided not to use the algorithm when it favored men over women. The proportion of male employees was very high and thus the AI's machine learning had an underlying bias towards male data. When analyzing the information provided by AI, it is always necessary to assess the quality of information — remember: garbage in, garbage out. Develop interpersonal skills that are particularly challenging for AI to replace. It is AI that is good at collecting and classifying information. Meanwhile, it is humans that are best at dealing with people. The ability to understand, empathize, and communicate with people emotionally is potentially the most important human ability that artificial intelligence cannot replace. For example, AI disease diagnostic programs, which are already used in many hospitals, may accurately diagnose a patient's illness such as cancer, but they don't have the human touch that can make eye contact, empathize with pain, share worries, hold hands, or give encouragement to patients in despair. It is human doctors who can cure the patient's emotional distress. Actually knowing and caring about what others think and feel is a unique competitive advantage we still possess. Become a life-long learner, embracing changes. According to a future job report published by a top global investment bank, up to 300 million jobs around the world could be affected by artificial intelligence. The report also noted that technological innovation has historically created employment growth in the long run. In the age of AI, the ability to adapt to new technologies and work environments is crucial. You must embrace change and be open to learning and mastering new skills. It is very likely that many of those without AI skills will be left behind. That is why we must become life-long learners. Continuous upskilling and reskilling will enable you to stay valuable in the changing job market. AI will replace some jobs but substantially alter many more. Furthermore, you probably won't be replaced by AI. More likely a person with AI skills will replace you. In conclusion, surviving and competing with AI requires a shift in mindset. Instead of fearing AI, we must embrace it as a companion in this new era and find ways to collaborate with it and complement it. We must also focus on developing interpersonal skills that machines cannot replace. By doing so, we can not only survive in this era of AI but also thrive and prosper.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ① was → were: 주어 people이 복수이므로 수동태 복수 동사 were
det.analysis:
① was → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'people with vast knowledge ___ considered to be the most talented'에서 주어는 people(복수)이에요. '여겨졌다'라는 수동태라 'be동사 + 과거분사(considered)' 형태인데 주어가 복수이므로 were로 써야 해요. was로 쓰면 수가 안 맞아 틀려요. ❌ was는 틀림 ←정답

② built: 'the famous stone castle built by Cormac MacCarthy'에서 성이 '지어진' 것이라 명사를 뒤에서 꾸미는 과거분사 built가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

③ used: 'used to be very popular'에서 'used to + 동사원형(~하곤 했다)' 표현이라 used가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

② dealing: 'best at dealing with people'에서 전치사 at 뒤라 동명사 dealing이 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② which → where: 선행사 an era(상황·시대) + 뒤에 완전한 절 → 관계부사 where
det.analysis:

② which → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'an era ___ the ability to use information is more important'에서 뒤 절(the ability ~ is ~)이 주어·동사·보어를 모두 갖춘 완전한 절이에요. 선행사 an era는 시간·상황을 나타내므로 관계부사 where로 써야 해요. which는 뒤에 불완전한 절이 와야 하므로 틀려요. ❌ which는 틀림 ←정답

③ memorized: 'having all the details memorized'에서 'have + 목적어 + 과거분사(~이 …되게 하다)' 구조라 memorized가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

④ focusing: 'rather than focusing on what AI does best'에서 rather than 뒤 동명사 focusing이 맞아요. ✅ 올바름
det.tip: 선행사(era) + 완전한 절 → 관계부사 where

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ trivial → important: 정보를 활용하는 능력이 암기보다 '더 중요하다(more important)'
det.analysis:
✅ ① rival: '방대한 정보를 외우는 데서 AI에 필적할(rival) 수 없다'는 문맥에 적절

✅ ④ best: 'what AI does best(AI가 가장 잘하는 것)'라는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: more important than ~(~보다 더 중요한) ↔ trivial(사소한)

det.korean: ② poorly → accurately: AI 진단 프로그램이 암을 '정확하게(accurately)' 진단한다
det.analysis:

❌ ② poorly(형편없이) → accurately(정확하게): 'AI disease diagnostic programs ~ may accurately diagnose a patient's illness such as cancer'에서 암 같은 병을 '정확하게' 진단한다는 뜻이므로 accurately가 맞다. poorly는 정반대 ← 정답

✅ ④ 여기가 정답(일치하지 않는 것)! 본문 'The fact that the computer won a resounding victory ~'에서 '컴퓨터'가 완승을 거뒀다고 했어요. '인간이 완승'은 정반대예요 ←정답
det.tip: the computer won a resounding victory(컴퓨터가 완승)가 사실입니다.

ch: 인터넷 이전에는 방대한 지식을 가진 사람들이 가장 능력 있는 사람으로 여겨졌다.
과거에는 어려운 문제가 나오는 퀴즈 쇼가 매우 인기 있었다.
2011년 한 인기 퀴즈 쇼의 74회 우승자가 슈퍼컴퓨터와 대결했다.
그 대결에서 인간이 슈퍼컴퓨터를 상대로 완승을 거두었다.

questions.passage: The ability to understand, empathize, and communicate with people emotionally is potentially the most important human ability that artificial intelligence cannot replace. For example, AI disease diagnostic programs, which are already used in many hospitals, may accurately diagnose a patient's illness such as cancer, but they don't have the human touch that can make eye contact, empathize with pain, share worries, hold hands, or give encouragement to patients in despair. It is human doctors who can cure the patient's emotional distress. Actually knowing and caring about what others think and feel is a unique competitive advantage we still possess. Become a life-long learner, embracing changes. According to a future job report published by a top global investment bank, up to 300 million jobs around the world could be affected by artificial intelligence. The report also noted that technological innovation has historically created employment growth in the long run. In the age of AI, the ability to adapt to new technologies and work environments is crucial.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: AI가 대체할 수 없는 인간의 능력.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 본문 'It is human doctors who can cure the patient's emotional distress'와 일치 ←정답

❌ ② 본문 'they don't have the human touch that can make eye contact ~ hold hands'에서 그런 인간적 손길이 '없다'고 했으므로 불일치

❌ ③ 본문 'Actually knowing and caring about what others think and feel is a unique competitive advantage we still possess'에서 '여전히 지닌' 고유 우위라고 했으므로 불일치

❌ ④ 본문 'the most important human ability that artificial intelligence cannot replace'에서 AI가 '대체할 수 없다'고 했으므로 불일치
det.tip: human doctors who can cure(치료하는 것은 인간 의사)가 일치. 나머지는 본문과 반대입니다.

ch: 환자의 정서적 고통을 치료할 수 있는 것은 바로 인간 의사이다.
인공지능 질병 진단 프로그램은 눈을 맞추고 손을 잡아주는 인간적 손길을 지닌다.
타인이 생각하고 느끼는 것을 아는 것은 더 이상 경쟁 우위가 아니다.
공감하고 소통하는 능력은 인공지능이 쉽게 대체할 수 있는 능력이다.

questions.passage: Become a life-long learner, embracing changes. According to a future job report ①<u>published</u> by a top global investment bank, up to 300 million jobs around the world could be affected by artificial intelligence. The report also ②<u>noted</u> that technological innovation has historically created employment growth in the long run. In the age of AI, the ability to adapt to new technologies and work environments is crucial. You must embrace change and be open to learning and ③<u>mastering</u> new skills. It is very likely that many of those without AI skills will be ④<u>leave</u> behind. That is why we must become life-long learners. Continuous upskilling and reskilling will enable you to stay valuable in the changing job market.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ④ leave → left: '뒤처지게 되다'는 수동태 be left behind, will be + 과거분사 left
det.analysis:
① published: 'a future job report published by a top global investment bank'에서 보고서가 '발행된' 것이라 명사를 뒤에서 꾸미는 과거분사 published가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

② noted: 'The report also noted that ~'에서 보고서가 과거에 '언급했다'는 내용이라 과거시제 noted가 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

③ mastering: 'be open to learning and mastering new skills'에서 전치사 to 뒤 동명사 learning과 and로 이어지는 병렬이라 동명사 mastering이 맞아요. ✅ 올바름

④ leave → 여기가 정답(틀린 곳)! 'many of those without AI skills will be ___ behind'는 '뒤처지게 되다'라는 수동의 의미예요. 'will be + 과거분사'의 미래 수동태라 left로 써야 해요(be left behind=뒤처지다). leave(동사원형)로 쓰면 틀려요. ❌ leave는 틀림 ←정답
det.tip: 미래 수동태 will be + 과거분사: will be left behind(뒤처지다)

questions.passage: AI can often find the information we want quickly, but there are problems with this. AI creates a lot of false or biased information. Further, AI cannot understand the intentions of the person who created the information, nor does it have the ability to judge whether the information is right or wrong. Moreover, stories of AI providing fake information are often reported. For example, there was a case of a lawyer who submitted non-existent cases made by AI to a real court. There has also been an example of AI recommending restaurants that didn't exist.
questions.stem: 위 글에 따르면, 인공지능은 'false(틀린)' 정보 외에 어떤 성격의 정보도 많이 만들어낸다고 했는지, 그 성격을 나타내는 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: AI가 만들어내는 문제 있는 정보의 성격.
det.analysis: 본문 'AI creates a lot of false or biased information.'에서 인공지능은 '틀린(false)' 또는 '편향된(biased)' 정보를 많이 만들어낸다고 했다. false 외에 언급된 성격은 biased(편향된)이다.
det.tip: false or biased information에서 biased를 찾습니다.

questions.passage: Meanwhile, it is humans that are best at dealing with people. The ability to understand, empathize, and communicate with people emotionally is potentially the most important human ability that artificial intelligence cannot replace. For example, AI disease diagnostic programs, which are already used in many hospitals, may accurately diagnose a patient's illness such as cancer, but they don't have the human touch that can make eye contact, empathize with pain, share worries, hold hands, or give encouragement to patients in despair. It is human doctors who can cure the patient's emotional distress. Actually knowing and caring about what others think and feel is a unique competitive advantage we still possess.
questions.stem: 위 글에 따르면, 타인이 생각하고 느끼는 것을 실제로 알고 마음을 쓰는 것은 우리가 여전히 지닌 '고유한 무엇'이라고 했는지, 그것을 나타내는 표현을 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오. (2단어, 영어로)

det.korean: 인간이 지닌 고유한 강점.
det.analysis: 본문 'Actually knowing and caring about what others think and feel is a unique competitive advantage we still possess.'에서 타인의 생각과 감정을 알고 마음 쓰는 것은 우리가 여전히 지닌 고유한 '경쟁 우위(competitive advantage)'라고 했다.
det.tip: a unique competitive advantage we still possess에서 competitive advantage를 찾습니다.

questions.passage: Develop interpersonal skills that are particularly challenging for AI to replace. It is AI that is good at __________ (collect) and classifying information. Meanwhile, it is humans that are best at dealing with people.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 흐름에 맞도록 괄호 안에 주어진 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (1단어, 영어로)

det.korean: collecting (전치사 뒤 동명사).
det.analysis: 구문 분석: 'good at ___ and classifying information'에서 빈칸은 전치사 at의 목적어 자리다. 전치사 뒤에는 동명사(-ing)가 와야 하고, 뒤의 classifying과 and로 병렬을 이루므로 collect를 collecting으로 바꿔야 한다. 'good at collecting and classifying(수집하고 분류하는 데 능숙한)'으로 해석된다.
det.tip: 전치사 at + 동명사, classifying과 병렬 → collecting

questions.passage: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is one of the biggest catch phrases these days. While cutting-edge technology might have benefits for many people, it is also a cause of concern for those trying to start a career. With so many jobs disappearing, what kind of career should you pursue, and what skills should you have to survive in the AI age? Whether you like it or hate it, AI technology is probably here to stay. Here are the core competencies you need to foster for a great career in the age of AI. Ask the right questions, rather than merely find answers. Before the Internet, people with vast knowledge were considered to be the most talented. Quiz shows with difficult questions, such as the name of the famous stone castle built by Cormac MacCarthy in 1446, used to be very popular.
questions.stem: 위 글의 주제로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글 전체를 아우르는 중심 소재.
det.analysis:
✅ ① 글은 올바른 질문하기, 비판적 사고, 대인관계 기술, 평생 학습 등 AI 시대에 살아남고 번영하기 위해 길러야 할 핵심 역량들을 다룸 ← 정답

❌ ② 퀴즈 쇼 대결은 하나의 예시일 뿐 주제가 아님

❌ ③ 질병 진단 프로그램은 대인관계 역량의 예시일 뿐임

❌ ④ 투자 은행 보고서 작성 방법은 본문에 없는 내용
det.tip: 네 가지 핵심 역량(질문·비판적 사고·대인관계·평생 학습)을 관통하는 것이 주제입니다.

ch: 인공지능 시대에 살아남고 번영하기 위해 길러야 할 핵심 역량들
슈퍼컴퓨터가 퀴즈 쇼에서 인간을 이긴 역사적 사건의 전말
인공지능 질병 진단 프로그램의 기술적 작동 원리
세계적 투자 은행이 미래 일자리 보고서를 작성하는 방법

questions.passage: Artificial Intelligence (AI) is one of the biggest catch phrases these days. While cutting-edge technology might have benefits for many people, it is also a cause of concern for those trying to start a career. With so many jobs disappearing, what kind of career should you pursue, and what skills should you have to survive in the AI age? Whether you like it or hate it, AI technology is probably here to stay. Here are the core competencies you need to foster for a great career in the age of AI. Ask the right questions, rather than merely find answers. Before the Internet, people with vast knowledge were considered to be the most talented. Quiz shows with difficult questions, such as the name of the famous stone castle built by Cormac MacCarthy in 1446, used to be very popular.
questions.stem: 위 글의 요지로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 글쓴이가 전하려는 핵심 메시지.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 본문은 'you probably won't be replaced by AI'라 하므로 '모든 일자리 완전 대체'는 반대

❌ ② 본문은 암기보다 '정보를 활용하는 능력'이 더 중요하다고 했으므로 반대

✅ ③ 본문 'Instead of fearing AI, we must embrace it as a companion ~ By doing so, we can not only survive ~ but also thrive and prosper'와 통하는 핵심 메시지 ← 정답

❌ ④ 본문은 AI가 'false or biased information'을 만든다며 정보의 질을 평가하라고 했으므로 반대
det.tip: AI를 동반자로 받아들이고 AI가 못하는 역량을 기르자는 것이 요지입니다.

ch: 인공지능은 결국 모든 인간의 일자리를 완전히 대체할 것이다.
사실을 빠르게 암기하는 능력이 앞으로도 가장 중요한 경쟁력이다.
AI를 동반자로 받아들이고 AI가 못하는 역량을 길러야 살아남고 번영할 수 있다.
인공지능이 제공하는 정보는 언제나 정확하므로 그대로 신뢰해야 한다.

questions.passage: It is very likely that many of those without AI skills will be left behind. That is why we must become life-long learners. Continuous upskilling and reskilling will enable you to stay valuable in the changing job market. __________. Furthermore, you probably won't be replaced by AI. More likely a person with AI skills will replace you. In conclusion, surviving and competing with AI requires a shift in mindset.
questions.stem:
다음 우리말 뜻에 맞도록 주어진 단어를 모두 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

"인공지능은 일부 직업을 대체하겠지만 더 많은 직업을 상당히 변화시킬 것이다." (10단어) (영어로) [조건] (1) AI, alter, but, jobs, many, more, replace, some, substantially, will 를 모두 사용 (2) 정확히 10단어로 쓸 것

det.korean: AI will replace some jobs but substantially alter many more
det.analysis:
주어는 AI, 미래 조동사 will 뒤에는 동사원형이 와요: AI + will + replace.

무엇을 대체하는가 하면 '일부 직업'이에요: some + jobs.

'하지만'은 but으로 잇고, '상당히'는 부사 substantially, '변화시키다'는 alter예요. will이 but 뒤 alter에도 걸리는 병렬이라 alter도 동사원형이에요: but + substantially + alter.

'더 많은 (직업)'은 many more로 마무리해요: many + more.

순서대로 이으면 AI / will / replace / some / jobs / but / substantially / alter / many / more.
det.tip: will replace ~ but (will) substantially alter ~: 조동사 will에 걸리는 동사원형 병렬

questions.wa: AI will replace some jobs but substantially alter many more
accept: AI will replace some jobs but substantially alter many more
